what: L1 B6: the language spells are drawn in (docs/design/LOOK_BIBLE.md rule 13). Per school: stepped bands on a 1D heat gradient (edge, mid, core in rising heat; t = the heat a band starts at, from MB5's area shares of the body), each band's color (Oklab L, C, h and hex: the displayed color it is FROM) and emit (the linear gain that lands it there through the night rig's exposure, AgX and grade, calibrated on the lookdev stage); a soft outer glow; painted sparks. Read by logic/Look/FxLanguage.cs; drawn by shaders/fx_cel.gdshaderinc. Written by tools/style/fx_measure.py build (re-run after moving a box); emit and t_tuned are the stage's and survive a rebuild.

fire.what: the FIRE panel's bolt in flight

derive.what: schools MB5 does not draw: edge and mid hue from Palette.Of's glow hue moved toward its core hue by edge_h and mid_h (fitted on MB5 fire: Palette glow 43, core 88 -> MB5 edge 36, mid 55); core hue Palette's core (its glow's where the core is white, C under 0.03); band L MB5's three-school mean; edge and mid C MB5 fire's times the school's glow C over fire's; core C max(core C, glow C / 4) x core_c (MB5 fire core 0.122 over Palette's 0.096); every C at most c_max (MB5's highest band, fire's edge 0.177: no school louder than fire) and inside sRGB at its L and h. Two bands where Palette's core and glow sit within 0.09 L and 0.09 C (physical): a third band would not read (MB5's bands step 0.14+ L).

glow.from: MB5 fire: rings of the backdrop's distance from the body (fx_measure.py): at the head L 0.45 at 2 px, 0.35 at 10 px, gone (0.24) by 30 px of an 85 px head radius; along the tail 0.33 at 2 px, gone by 10 px
glow.units: width: the e-fold of the falloff and reach: where it ends, both in head radii; head, tail: its strength at the body's edge, (glow L - backdrop L) / (edge band L - backdrop L)

sparks.from: MB5 fire: 23 small parts off the body (4-150 px, scipy label of L > 0.5, C > 0.08), median 8 x 5 px on a 438 px bolt, L 0.64 C 0.155 h 56
